compatibility.policy: additive fields are compatible; removals require a major version and explicit baseline update

post.description: Authenticated HTTP bridge mode. The client sends `agentId` plus either a single JSON-RPC command object or a JSON-RPC batch array (max 32 items). The API forwards the payload to the connected agent over Socket.IO (/agents), waits for response when at least one command has non-null `id`, and returns a normalized response. The authenticated user (`sub` in the JWT) must be linked to `agentId` via the user→agent list (admin-managed); otherwise the call fails with `403`. The agent must exist in the catalog and be `active`. If `id` is omitted, the server assigns a UUID before forwarding so the agent can correlate `rpc:response` (HTTP `200`). Explicit `id: null` is a JSON-RPC notification: no response is awaited and the route returns `202 Accepted` when every item is a notification. Top-level `pagination` is supported only for single `sql.execute` and is injected into `command.params.options` before dispatch. Socket payload hardening is enabled in the bridge layer: compressed payload max 10MB, decoded payload max 10MB, max inflation ratio 10x, and optional HMAC signature verification when the frame includes `signature`. Optional `payloadFrameCompression` on the body selects gzip policy for PayloadFrames the hub emits on `rpc:request` toward the agent (`default` = auto above 4096 B, `none`, `always`). Rate limits: per JWT `sub` (`REST_AGENTS_COMMANDS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX` / `_WINDOW_MS`); optional per-IP cap when `REST_AGENTS_COMMANDS_RATE_LIMIT_IP_MAX` > 0 (use `trust proxy` behind reverse proxies). See `components.schemas.SocketBridgeSecurityNotes` for the documented hardening profile.

INSERT INTO audit_logs (entity, entity_id, action) VALUES ('user', :id, 'status_change')

200.description: Command proxied and normalized JSON-RPC response returned (success or agent-side error). When the agent exists in the catalog but has no live `/agents` socket, correlatable requests return HTTP 200 with a normalized JSON-RPC error (`code: -32000`, `message: agent_offline`) instead of HTTP 503; pure-notification batches remain 503 in that offline case.

Refresh token transport follows `RefreshTokenTransport`: JSON body and/or HttpOnly `client_refresh_token` cookie. When both are sent, **body > cookie** (non-empty body wins).

200.description: Paginated list of agent access requests for the authenticated client

delete.description: Removes `ClientAgentAccess` rows. If the paired request was `approved`, it is marked `revoked` with reason `client_revoked_access`.

post.description: Validates each `agentId`. If approved access already exists (`ClientAgentAccess`), returns that id in `alreadyApproved` and does not email the owner. Otherwise creates or refreshes a `pending` `ClientAgentAccessRequest` (including after the client removed access with `DELETE /client/me/agents` while the prior request row was still `approved`), issues a new approval token, and emails the agent owner.

alreadyApproved.description: Agent IDs that already had `ClientAgentAccess` for this client

debounced.description: Agent IDs skipped because a pending request was refreshed within the debounce window (no new email)

newRequests.description: Subset of `requested` with no prior `ClientAgentAccessRequest` row

reopened.description: Subset of `requested` that reopened an existing request row

requested.description: Agent IDs for which a pending request was saved and the owner was emailed in this call

404.description: One or more agents not found

409.description: Maximum retry attempts reached for one of the requested agents (`CLIENT_AGENT_ACCESS_MAX_RETRIES`, default 5). The `retryCount` on `ClientAgentAccessRequestRecord` shows how many times this client already retried.

post.summary: Request access to one or more agents

delete.summary: Remove approved client access for one agent (path variant)

get.description:
Returns the bearer token the authenticated client has stored for use with this agent. The token is forwarded to the agent as `sql.execute params.client_token` (and aliases `clientToken`/`auth`) on the SQL bridge. Returns `null` when no token is stored yet.
The value is **only** returned by this dedicated endpoint — list and detail endpoints expose `hasClientToken: boolean` instead, so the token never leaks through paginated browsing.

200.description: Stored token (or null when not configured)

403.description: Client does not have approved access to this agent

get.summary: Read the per-(client, agent) bearer token stored on the server

put.description:
Replaces the stored bearer token for this client+agent pair. Send `clientToken: null` (or an empty string) to clear it.
Token length is capped at 512 chars (DB column `client_agent_accesses.client_token`). The client must already have approved access to the agent — this route does **not** create the access row.

403.description: Client does not have approved access to this agent

put.summary: Store or clear the per-(client, agent) bearer token

profileVersion.description: Monotonic profile revision counter on the server.

AgentCommandPagination.description: Supported only for single sql.execute and translated to command.params.options (page_size/cursor).

payloadFrameCompression.description: Optional gzip for hub-originated PayloadFrames on `rpc:request` to the agent. `default`: above 4096 bytes, gzip only if smaller than raw JSON (auto, aligned with plug_agente). `none`: never gzip. `always`: prefer gzip whenever eligible (always_gzip), even if compressed size is larger, but never emit a frame that exceeds the negotiated inflation-ratio guard.

timeoutMs.description: Max wait for agent response (ms). Raised automatically toward SQL command options.timeout_ms when higher.

AgentSelfProfilePatchRequest.description: Partial self-service agent profile update. Omitted fields keep their current value; null clears optional fields.

document.description: When set, must normalize to a valid Brazilian CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) with correct check digits; punctuation is stripped before validation and storage.

expectedProfileVersion.description: Optional CAS token: must match current server profileVersion or the request is rejected with 409.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional idempotency key when the Idempotency-Key header is not used. Prefer the header for HTTP clients.

AuthTokens.description: Legacy flat success shape for auth token endpoints (not wrapped in `{ success, data }`). Includes `token` as an alias for `accessToken` for plug_agente compatibility.

BridgeCommand.description: Single JSON-RPC object or batch array (max 32). Missing id is auto-filled with a UUID by the server for REST and agents:command; use id: null for fire-and-forget notifications.

hasClientToken.description: Whether the authenticated client has stored a per-(client, agent) bearer token (used as `sql.execute params.client_token`). The actual value is **not** returned by listing/detail endpoints — fetch it via `GET /client/me/agents/{agentId}/client-token`.

isHubConnected.description: Snapshot at response time: whether this hub process currently has this agent registered on the /agents Socket.IO namespace after agent:register. May change between polls; with refresh=true the value reflects the registry after any live profile work for that request. Per-process: false if the agent is connected only to another replica or not registered on this instance. Not the same as catalog status (active/inactive). When `HUB_INSTANCE_ID` is set, every Express response (REST, Swagger, /metrics, 404) carries header `X-Hub-Instance-Id` for sticky-session validation and replica correlation.

profileVersion.description: Monotonic profile revision counter on the server.

ClientAgentAccessRequestRecord.description: A client-to-agent access request with its current status and retry counter.

retryCount.description: Number of times the client has retried this request after rejection/expiry/revocation. Blocked at CLIENT_AGENT_ACCESS_MAX_RETRIES (default 5; 0 = unlimited).

clientToken.description: Bearer token used by the SQL bridge to authorize this client on the agent. Pass `null` (or an empty string, normalized to `null`) to clear the stored token.
Currently stored token. `null` when no token is configured.

thumbnailUrl.description: Normalized thumbnail URL generated by the server.

message.example: If the account exists, a password recovery email will be sent shortly.

ClientPatchMeRequest.description: Partial profile update. `thumbnailUrl: null` removes the current thumbnail; new thumbnails must be uploaded via `/client-auth/thumbnail`.

oneOf.description: Brazilian mobile number; normalized to E.164.

thumbnailUrl.description: Remove current thumbnail. Use `/client-auth/thumbnail` to upload a new one.

event.description: JSON string matching ClientSocketEventPublishRequest. Files are sent in repeated `files` fields and delivered as inline base64 attachments.

ClientSocketEventPublishRequest.description: Same logical fields as `socket:event.publish` on `/consumers` for `Client` JWTs. REST uses HTTP rate limits (`REST_SOCKET_EVENT_RATE_LIMIT_*`). Socket uses a separate counter; defaults mirror those env vars, with optional overrides `SOCKET_CUSTOM_EVENT_PUBLISH_RATE_LIMIT_*` (see `docs/configuration.md`).

eventName.description: Custom event name. Only the reserved client:custom.* prefix is accepted; internal Socket protocol events are blocked.

payload.description: JSON payload delivered inside the outbound PayloadFrame.

payloadFrameCompression.description: Compression policy used when the hub emits the PayloadFrame to subscribed consumers.

idempotencyKey.description: Echoed when the request used Idempotency-Key.

idempotentReplay.description: True when this response was replayed from the Idempotency-Key cache without emitting a duplicate Socket event.

recipients.description: Number of local sockets subscribed to the event on this hub instance at publish time.

details.description: Optional payload for specific codes (non-production may echo more fields). Example: `AGENT_NOT_ONLINE_FOR_USER` includes `reason`: `offline` | `different_account`.

HttpSuccessEnvelope.description: Canonical success envelope for new JSON endpoints. Auth login/refresh/logout keep the legacy flat `AuthTokens` shape documented below.

JsonRpcId.description: JSON-RPC request id. Omit: hub assigns a UUID before forwarding (await response). null: JSON-RPC notification (no response). String or number: forwarded as-is.

allOf.description: Owner inbox shape for `GET /me/client-access-requests`. Adds requesting client identity fields.

clientEmail.description: Email of the client that requested access.

clientName.description: Display name of the requesting client.

RedisModuleHealth.description: Per-module Redis liveness snapshot used by `GET /health/redis`. `skipped` means the module is opt-in and its URL is empty; `disconnected` means the URL is configured but the connection dropped; `circuit_open` is the short-lived breaker state after repeated command failures.

active.description: True when the module's Redis store is online and ready.

circuitOpen.description: Circuit breaker state for modules that have one (socket/REST rate-limit). Omitted for modules without a breaker.

lastConnectionAtMs.description: Timestamp (ms since epoch) of the last successful connect event. 0 = never connected.

lastFallbackAtMs.description: Timestamp (ms since epoch) of the last fallback event (connect/command failure). 0 = no fallback recorded.

reason.description: Set only when active=false. Distinguishes opt-in skip from outage.

RefreshTokenTransport.description: Refresh token transport for `/auth/refresh`, `/auth/logout`, `/client-auth/refresh`, and `/client-auth/logout`. Accepts `refreshToken` in the JSON body and/or an HttpOnly cookie (`refresh_token` for user auth, `client_refresh_token` for client auth). **Precedence when both are present: body > cookie** — a non-empty body value wins even if the cookie differs.

refreshToken.description: Optional in JSON body. When present and non-empty, takes precedence over the HttpOnly cookie.

RpcAgentActionCorrelationParams.description: Published correlation and token aliases for agent.action.* remote calls.

RpcClientTokenCarrierParams.description: Optional client_token / clientToken / auth aliases accepted by agent.getHealth, agent.getProfile and client_token.getPolicy; serialized JSON max 65536 UTF-8 bytes (Zod).

RpcDiscoverParams.description: Optional free-form params; serialized JSON max 65536 UTF-8 bytes (Zod).

RpcMeta.description: Bridge input metadata. The hub forwards only the published plug_agente fields (`trace_id`, `traceparent`, `tracestate`, `request_id`, `agent_id`, `timestamp`) to the agent; compatibility-only fields like `outbound_compression` are accepted on input but stripped before forwarding.

outbound_compression.description: Compatibility-only input accepted by the hub for older clients. It is not forwarded to plug_agente because the published transport contract does not support per-request compression overrides.

SocketBridgeSecurityNotes.description: Security and transport hardening notes applied to HTTP-to-Socket bridge flow.

maxCompressedPayloadBytes.description: Maximum accepted compressed PayloadFrame size in bytes.

maxDecodedPayloadBytes.description: Maximum accepted decoded PayloadFrame size in bytes.

maxInflationRatio.description: Maximum allowed decoded/compressed ratio for gzip frames.

SqlBulkInsertOptions.description: timeout_ms max 300000, same as sql.execute options.

SqlBulkInsertParams.description: Native ODBC bulk insert params. Each row must have the same length and order as columns.

params.description: JSON max 2097152 UTF-8 bytes when serialized.

sql.description: Max 1048576 UTF-8 bytes per command (matches Zod).

SqlExecuteBatchOptions.description: timeout_ms max 300000 and max_rows max 1000000, same as sql.execute options.

max_parallel_read_only_batch_items.description: Pass-through opt-in parallelism for non-transactional read-only SELECT batches; plug_agente applies its own safety cap.

SqlExecuteOptions.description: Numeric limits match Zod validation: timeout_ms max 300000, max_rows max 1000000, page_size max 50000.

execution_mode.description: SQL handling mode. managed (default) allows agent-managed pagination rewriting. preserve executes SQL exactly as sent. Cannot be combined with page, page_size or cursor.

prefer_db_streaming.description: Pass-through preference for plug_agente direct DB streaming on eligible unpaginated SELECTs; final routing remains agent-side.

preserve_sql.description: Deprecated alias for execution_mode=preserve. Cannot be combined with page, page_size or cursor.

SqlExecuteParams.description: Logical JSON limits before PayloadFrame (UTF-8 bytes): `sql` max 1048576; serialized `params` max 2097152.

params.description: Named parameters; JSON max 2097152 UTF-8 bytes when serialized.
